text:
alex: Kicking off night-slot deploy for kernel-quant v7.2. Rolling to night buckets in us-west first. Staged slices: 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 10m hold each. Need smoke+latency check. window 23:00-03:00 PST. cc @oncall

maria: Thanks — do we have explicit rollback triggers? last time memory growth slipped.

sam: Rollback if p95 latency > baseline +40ms for two consecutive 5m buckets OR OOM rate > 0.1% across region. Also fail canary if top-1 accuracy regress > 2% on evalset.

jen: For the evalset check, which dataset? use /mnt/evals/quant_smoke_v2

alex: yep that's the set. smoke steps:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/generate -d '{"model":"kernel-quant:v7.2","prompt":"smoke test"}'
# verify kv-cache hit rate: host:9000/metrics | grep kv_cache_hit
```

deploybot: Rollout started: kernel-quant:v7.2 -> night-slot-us-west. slice=0.10 state=progressing

opsbot: Canary metrics snapshot: p95=190ms (baseline 150ms), cpu=42%, kv_cache_hit=0.87

maria: p95 looks high. Is that during warmup? what's sequence len distribution?

alex: Canary traffic included long sequences (~1024) to stress. We'll observe next 10m and hold if still high.

sam: If p95 doesn't reduce by 20ms within 10m, I want to abort and pin previous kernel v7.1

nate: Pin TTL? prefer 24h sticky pin to give SRE time to triage.

jen: Release notes: I'll push a short blurb to GH release notes and the releasepad doc. Reminder: include quantization caveats (mixed precision, minor perf variance on A100).

alex: Noting: push release notes link when done. tagging @release for visibility

deploybot: slice=0.30 state=progressing

opsbot: New snapshot: p95=165ms, cpu=45%, kv_cache_hit=0.88

maria: That looks acceptable. continuing

alex: Hold and monitor for 10m. If stable, finish remainder of rollout.

sam: I'll stand by to trigger rollback if metrics cross triggers. :eyes: 

jen: Release notes pushed: https://github.com/redwood/releasepad/runs/1256 :memo:

alex: Final slice to 100% in 5m

deploybot: Rollout completed: kernel-quant:v7.2 state=complete

maria: Nice. post-deploy checklist: watch retention for 6h, if anything odd open incident

nate: pin removed after 24h per TTL

alex: Thanks team — great coordination. :party:
